The '''[[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] battle tank''' was a sturdy tank known by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. A Mandalorian guard captain once compared a [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkeg]] to one.
